title: Board Networks and Corporate Innovation
near_miss_reason: Staggered event design (director deaths and retirements in different years; treated = departing director had at least one connection, control = unconnected departures), but every Table 4/5 column includes an After indicator defined for all firms at their own event year (extra treatment regressor), all time-varying firm controls from Table 3, director FE as an additional additive FE, and event-stacked firm-year windows (five years around each event, firms with multiple events repeated). Models 3-4 use a continuous Connected (number of connections). The 2003 listing-rule DiD has a single common date.
main_or_robustness: robustness (identification section; baseline is OLS of innovation on board connectedness)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: After (extra treatment regressor), time-varying controls, director FE, stacked event windows
continuous treatment (number of connections) plus the violations above

ineligible_specs.reported_location: Table 4 Panels B (deaths) and C (sudden deaths)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: PSM-matched sample with the same violations as Table 4

eligible_reason: No qualifying column. Table 4 (Panels A-F) and Table 5 (PSM-matched) estimate Ln(Patent)/Ln(Cite) on After x Connected and After with all Table 3 controls and director, firm and year FE on stacked five-year event windows; these violate the time-varying-controls, extra-treatment-regressor (After for all event firms), extra-FE (director) and stacking rules. The regulatory-shock DiD (2003 NYSE/NASDAQ listing rules, POSTSOX) uses one common date. Baseline Table 3 is OLS on continuous connectedness.
design_notes: Text Section 4.2: 373 deaths and 2,502 retirements (283 and 2,012 connected); 'our panel includes firm-year observations for each event'; After = 1 for years after the event; Connected = 1 if the departing director had at least one connection; controls as in Table 3; director, firm and year FE; SE clustered by firm. Table 4 Panel A col 1: After x Connected -0.336 (t = -7.13), After -0.269, N = 16,630. Panels D-F are pseudo-event placebos. Table 5: PSM-matched sample.
data_files_note: Package ships only a SAS data-preparation program (codeprep.sas) and a README; data come from Compustat, BoardEx and patent databases (licensed); no regression code or analysis data.
software_notes: SAS data preparation only; estimation code not shipped
screener_notes: Published PDF read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2020.3587.txt). Near miss with several violations, so it does not enter the 5c controls-only analysis.
